content: Bhatumika saba bha kunani kumahunde na malapuliku saba gha kujomukela

Bhela, nakaweni kabheti nginyulila jengi kunani kumahunde, ngolongwa na ja kukangacha. Panihapa pakabhi na bhatumika saba bha kunani kumahunde bhabhakabhi na malapuliku saba gha kujomukela. Kwa kupetela malapuliku saba hagha, inyela jaka Chapanga jitimie.

Kabhete nakaweni chindu ulenganesu wa bahali ja chioo jejihangaghinwi na moto. Punkeghi ja bahali heji, bhakabhi bhajemiki bhandu bhala bhabhachiweziki chinyama chela na chimong'umong'u chaki papamu na namba ja lihina laki. Mumabhoku ghabhu bhakabhi bhakamwi ilimba yebhakapekiwi na Chapanga.
Bhakabhi bhajemba lunyembu lwaka Musa, mtumika waka Chapanga, na lunyembu lwaka Mwanambelele, bhakapwaghaje,

content.text: matendu ghaku nde makolongwa na gha kukangacha!
indela yaku nde yamboni na ya chakaka!
Bho, nde nane ambaju ngaakutopeli wehapa, wa Bambo
Maghambu wehapa kanjika jaku nde Mhuhu.
Kwa ndandi mataifa ghokapi gha pundema anaghahikaje,
kwa kubha matendu ghaku gha wamboni ghajomwi kuyekuliwa.”

content: Paghapetiki ghanihagha nakaweni Nyumba jaka Chapanga jihoghuliwi kunani kumahunde, na mkati jaki kukabhi na Lihema la Ulandilu.

Mkati ja Nyumba jaka Chapanga jela bhakapitiki bhatumika saba bha kunani kumahunde bhabhakabhi na malapuliku saba. Bhakabhi bhawati ingobhu ihuhu yeyakabhi ing'anya, na pa ihimba yabhu bhakongakiki ulamba wa zahabu kuhuma mulubhegha mbaka mwindeta.
Jumu wa ihumbi yomi nchechi bhala akabhapeki bhatumika saba bha kunani kumahunde bhala mbale saba ya zahabu, yakabhi itwelili inyela jaka Chapanga, joabhi mwome mileli na mileli.

Nyumba jaka Chapanga jela jakatwelakiki lyohi lelibhokana na ulumbalilu waka Chapanga na lujiniku lwaki. Wala ngachepakabhi na mundu joaweza kujingila mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga homu, mbaka ghajomukaje malapuliku saba gha bhatumika saba bha kunani kumahunde bhala.
